# Security policy

Report a vulnerability privately through
[GitHub's form](https://github.com/its-magdy/evalup/security/advisories/new)
(Security → Report a vulnerability), not in a public issue.

evalup is maintained by one person, so there is no fixed response time. A
report will be acknowledged, and a confirmed issue is fixed on `main` and
credited unless you ask otherwise. Only the latest `main` is supported.

In scope: the plugin under `evalup/`. That covers the scripts that call your
app, parse its responses and traces, and render the review page, and the
skills' instructions to Claude Code. Findings in an app you point evalup at
belong to that app's owner.
